objective: Deliver a usable game from the confirmed brief with sufficient design decisions, bounded independent review, and actual content/runtime acceptance; document bookkeeping is not proof of game quality.
scope: BGS system source, professional instructions, and synthetic regression fixtures only. Existing generated project products and paid-test evidence remain read-only.
approvedFlow: Write necessary design documents in dependency order using scoped author contexts.
Run one joint independent inspect after all planned design drafts are saved.
If needed, perform one source-backed correction pass and targeted verification; unresolved blockers stop rather than becoming PASS.
Create actual resources and formal content, implement, and verify actual game behavior against the original brief and owned acceptance expectations.
remove: Automatic full inspect/revise/verify after every author batch.
Design-sidecar copies of gameplay states, audio behavior, tuning values, resource specifications, input mappings, and repeated dependency-status ledgers.
Model-maintained duplicate document versions and evidence hashes.
Mandatory temporary Scene/UI/simulation models and generated appendices for every design draft regardless of a concrete feasibility question.
retain: Eight professional document files, proportionate detail, dependency-aware authorship, and prompt-defined ownership.
Only downstream-consumed design references and observable acceptance pointers, with original source identity.
Useful optional calculations for consequential factual or quantitative questions; no unsupported claim of prior verification.
Explicit original requirements, source-backed blocker findings, affected-scope revision permissions, review independence, and stop rules.
Program-maintained versions and evidence byte identity, read-only validation, and released-baseline integrity checks.
Actual resource/content validation, formal layout checks, runtime evidence, and refusal to pass failed or missing acceptance.

execution.rootRole: audit, interface decisions, integration checks, and corrections

owners.workflow_executor: Scheduling, review scope, host completion boundaries, and workflow regression tests.
owners.handoff_executor: Minimal design reference interface, host metadata finalization, downstream consumers, and contract regression tests.
owners.prompt_executor: Author/reviewer/native instructions, Skills, removal of compulsory duplicate calculation work, and instruction tests.

integrationConstraints: Keep existing correct work and unrelated dirty changes; no repository reset or broad rollback.
Do not introduce a new orchestration framework, decision taxonomy, additional review role, or automatic retry loop.
Do not inflate review turn limits to hide oversized work.
Legacy interfaces and in-progress sessions must be explicitly handled or safely rejected, never silently passed.
Host metadata finalization happens only at an authorized write-completion boundary, never inside a read-only checker.
No case-specific rules or prefilled expected answers from prior paid projects.

localAcceptance: All dependency writing batches can advance without intermediate semantic reviews; exactly one initial joint inspect sees all saved documents.
Missing drafts, incomplete native turns, invalid source references, unresolved blockers, unauthorized revisions, and stale released baselines cannot advance as successful delivery.
Minimal reference records work without duplicated design tables; runtime acceptance still binds the actual source version and rejects absent or failed required evidence.
Actual revision increases the document version; unchanged completion does not create version churn; evidence hashes reflect retained bytes without asserting their semantic adequacy.
Prompts and relevant Skills agree on optional proportional design calculations and mandatory validation of actual consumed content/runtime data.
Regression tests and type checks pass within the touched system surface; failures are reported without treating test count as semantic quality proof.

paidAcceptance.authorization: Not included in this implementation turn.
paidAcceptance.futureCriterion: Independent new ideas complete native end-to-end delivery without observer edits to products; actual games satisfy the original brief. Local tests cannot establish this result.

knownTradeoffs: Some cross-document problems will be detected later in drafting and may require document rework.
Fewer stages and less bookkeeping do not prove better model judgment or lower actual paid cost.
Joint review still has finite model capacity; an unfinished review must remain unfinished.
Legacy intermediate-review sessions safe-stop rather than silently migrating. No automatic migration or rewriting of historical project products was introduced.

rootAuditCorrections.issue: Removing intermediate reviews also removes their byte-bound protection of already handed-off drafts.
rootAuditCorrections.resolution: Retain one current designDrafts snapshot solely for out-of-scope write detection. It never authorizes production and is cleared when the joint review establishes the baseline. No new audit stage or decision ledger.

rootAuditCorrections.issue: Host version finalization could become another early quality gate or act on an ordinary chat result.
rootAuditCorrections.resolution: Bind snapshots to an actually scheduled successful native author/revision turn. Keep finalization in the existing serialized advance gate. Missing/empty/failed/stale turns cannot stamp or advance. Ordinary draft index/reference diagnostics go to the single joint review; unsafe paths and real write failures stop immediately.

rootAuditCorrections.issue: Containment checks alone permit a symlink to rewrite a different in-workspace document.
rootAuditCorrections.resolution: Reject symlinks in the exact document/index target or its ancestors; finalize only the pre-captured authorized document scope. Read-only checks do not mutate files.

rootAuditCorrections.issue: Automatically changing the document Version header would invalidate otherwise unchanged calculation source hashes.
rootAuditCorrections.resolution: For the eight known design documents only, calculation readers and hashes use the same body excluding a unique valid Version line; appendices explicitly state hash scope. Actual body/model changes remain detectable; other inputs and runtime acceptance retain exact-byte identity. Cross-module revision/finalization/verify regression passed.

rootAuditCorrections.issue: Actual user Stop records session.stopped, while the new trusted dispatch boundary initially recognized only turn.failed recovery.
rootAuditCorrections.resolution: Recognize the latest stop or failed terminal event as interruption recovery. A later completed turn supersedes it. Route and lifecycle regressions cover resumed delivery, queued messages and ordinary questions that must not redispatch writers.
